about: [O5 critic] 2 bout(s) at the gym, my good hands (c4_bot), in by the door

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('gym'), d = s.door; const x = d.x + d.nx * 3, z = d.z + d.nz * 3; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(x, z); N.controller.setPose(x, z, Math.atan2(d.nx, d.nz), -0.05); window.__m0 = G.save.money || 0; window.__res = []; G.on('bout', (e) => { if (e.over) window.__res.push({ t: +G.time.toFixed(0), won: G.brawl.stats && G.brawl.stats.won, lv: e.level, downs: G.brawl.stats && G.brawl.stats.downs, warned: G.brawl.stats && G.brawl.stats.downWarned }); }); return 1; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const F = G.city.places.byId.get('gym').frame; return [[0, -1.8]].map(([x, z]) => { const p = F.w(x, z); return [p.x, p.z]; }); })()
(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('gym'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const p = F.w(K.man.x - 1.2, K.man.z + 0.9); return [[p.x, p.z]]; })()

steps.look: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('gym'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K, a = F.v(K.man.x, 1.75, K.man.z); const dx = a.x - G.eye.x, dz = a.z - G.eye.z, dy = a.y - G.eye.y; const w = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz); const e = Math.atan2(Math.sin(w - N.controller.yaw), Math.cos(w - N.controller.yaw)); const p = Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz)); return [Math.round(-e / N.controller.sensitivity), Math.round(-(p - N.controller.pitch) / N.controller.sensitivity)]; })()
